11\. A send to the builder can stall the daemon on git 🐞 Bug ☼ Reliability 
Api._send calls PlaybookEngine.journal_reminder() straight from the event loop. That runs a
blocking git status --porcelain (10 s timeout) and reads the whole inbox through spool.events().
On every cli send and every phone answer to the builder, a slow or locked repository freezes the
queue, the socket and the phone channel for that time; progress_report avoids the same problem by
moving its git calls to a thread.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The journal reminder's git call and inbox scan run synchronously on the daemon's event loop. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/hands/api.py[340-346] ## Recommended Fix Replace `reminder = self.daemon.playbook.journal_reminder()` with `reminder = await asyncio.to_thread(self.daemon.playbook.journal_reminder)`, as `progress_report` does for its git calls. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
